generation.mode: built-in ImageGen edit with edit-target as Image 1 and canon as reference-only Image 2

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; water-mask pixels and adjacent pixels excluded, and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No cast-shadow field or explicit sun is visible, but pale column caps, darker cliff faces, and modelled panel faces violate the literal same-value-on-every-side rule; the aggregate metric cannot override that visual failure.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: Manual screen-space estimate over non-water land at native source resolution.
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The broad coherent cliff-top bench and western level shelf count as buildable; exposed sea-cliff and stack faces count as steep; talus, broken rims, rune cuts, panels, scrub, and conifer footprints make up the remainder.
buildableVsSteepFraction.limitation: Visual estimate rather than elevation-derived slope or world-space surface area; approximate uncertainty is plus or minus 0.08 per land-relative fraction.

crown.method: Full-frame manual outer-foliage-width census at native 1254 px of all 25 visually distinguishable conifer crowns, including saplings, overlapping crowns, and north- and south-clipped arrivals; median source width 34 px scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.derivation: Flooded the edge-connected teal source surface from the east edge, expanded through adjacent wet neutral, pale surf, wash, ripple, and reflection pixels, and filled enclosed classifier gaps of at most 64 pixels.
waterMask.interiorTransparentTerrainNote: The remaining enclosed transparent island is visibly dry sea-stack rock and talus, not omitted water texture; the rune line through the sea is also deliberately unmasked so no water occupies it.

refusalReasons: The rune line does not preserve the full purple guide trajectory: it begins near the supplied western position but straightens substantially and exits the eastern edge above the guide's supplied endpoint.
The rune feature reads mainly as a raised, kerbed strip across land and water rather than a slot cut down into bedrock with two visible cut walls and a recessed floor.
Repeated pale column caps over darker vertical faces, plus modelled panel faces, violate the literal neutral-lighting rule even though no cast shadows or explicit sun are visible.
Several long cliff sections retain regular upright, similarly capped column rhythms rather than the required uneven, split, leaning, broken ordinary coast.

The south-edge water handover merges into a broad coastal surface; the required arriving watercourse is not visually distinct enough to verify its width or exact seam meeting from the authored result.
openRisks: The source is square, so the framing-only retry exception does not authorize another ImageGen call; the visual defects cannot be corrected within this task's one-call contract.
The water-mask overlay was inspected at source resolution and covers the connected sea, foam, wash, ripples, and reflections, but no shipped-canvas bake was run because this task is quarantine-only.
Buildable and steep fractions and crown widths are image measurements rather than surveyed geometry.
Exact seam continuity, coastline naturalism, and visual quality remain director and owner judgments; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
